title: Way to Crete | Private & Bespoke Experiences in Crete
name: Andi Muca
text:
We had a wonderful food tasting experience in Crete with Way to Crete. The tour focused on two of the island’s most important local products: honey and olive oil. We tasted three different varieties of Cretan honey — carob, pine and thyme honey — and it was fascinating to discover how different their aromas and flavours were.

We also had the opportunity to taste Koroneiki olive oil through a food pairing experience, trying it with different local foods and learning how to appreciate its flavour, aroma and characteristics. Ernesto was our guide and made the experience very interesting, relaxed and enjoyable. He shared a lot of knowledge about Cretan traditions, olive oil production and local gastronomy.

A fantastic experience for anyone who wants to discover the authentic flavours of Crete beyond the usual tourist attractions.

We visited the beautiful Yous Kampos, a stunning plain full of wild orchids and spring flowers—truly breathtaking. We saw Tulipa doerfleri, Orchis italica, Ophrys heldreichii, Anacamptis boryi, Himantoglossum robertianum, Orchis pauciflora, and many more!
Our guide Ernesto was polite, friendly, and very knowledgeable, making the whole experience even more special.
Highly recommended for flower lovers looking for an authentic side of Crete!

title: Way to Crete | Private & Bespoke Experiences in Crete
name: eugenia manou
text:
Αν θέλετε να ζήσετε την Κρήτη με τον πιο αυθεντικό και συναρπαστικό τρόπο, τότε το waytocrete είναι η καλύτερη επιλογή .
Πρόσφατα συμμετείχα σε μια εκδρομή στο Φαράγγι των Μύλων στο Ρεθυμνο και μπορώ να πω με σιγουριά ότι ήταν μια από τις καλύτερες εμπειριες μου στην Κρήτη.
Από την πρώτη στιγμή που επικοινωνήσαμε μαζί τους , φάνηκαν εξαιρετικά φιλικοί και επαγγελματίες , έτοιμη να καλύψουν κάθε μας ανάγκη . Αυτό που πραγματικά μας εντυπωσίασε ήταν η προσοχή στην λεπτομέρεια , η καλή οργάνωση και η φροντίδα που έδειξαν σε κάθε στάδιο της εμπειρίας μας . Επιπλέον , ήταν πολύ πρόθυμοι να προσαρμόσουν το πρόγραμμα στις προτιμήσεις μας , κάνοντας την εμπειρία μας ακόμα πιο προσωπική και ξεχωριστή !

title: Way to Crete | Private & Bespoke Experiences in Crete
name: Pavlos Marakis
text:
I recently took a guided tour with Way to Crete through Preveli and Patsos-Arkadi, and it was an incredible experience. The tour guides were fantastic—knowledgeable, friendly, and engaging, making the trip both informative and enjoyable.

Preveli's stunning beach and palm forest were breathtaking, and we had a lot of
time to take it all in. Patsos-Arkadi, with its historical Arkadi Monastery, was equally captivating, brought to life by the guides' fascinating stories.

Way to Crete's attention to detail and seamless planning made the tour smooth and enjoyable. I highly recommend Way to Crete for anyone wanting to explore these beautiful regions. This tour was a highlight of my trip!
